note: Mutants of the play counter (web/replay_plays.js and its call in web/shell.html; docs/REPLAYS.md 'Watching a replay') for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'), against tests/scripts/web_plays_check.js (a fake clock, window, storage and fetch, and the page's own call): a play that is 9 or 11 seconds, a pause, a jump, a hidden tab or a shown tab that counts wrongly, a look after a pause that counts, a gap between two looks that is not capped or takes time away, the page that looks too rarely, the once-a-day rule forgotten, never written, written after the play, a day that is two days or an hour, an old entry or one from the future that stays, a memory that keeps all, 201, 199 or the oldest, a storage that throws when it is asked for, read or written, a page view that cannot remember and counts again and again, a play that fails and is sent again or is not caught, a fetch that throws, a play that carries cookies, is a GET or names no recording, a timer that never stops, a game that throws, any text taken for an id, and the page's call: a live match, a file of your own or an address that is no recording that counts, a jump or anything but playing that counts, the wrong value, the script fetched without the build's version or never started or given the file for the id; every one must be caught (tools/mutate.py tests/data/replay_plays_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1).
